6cdaa58b92.q: What are the four types of stories that every business owner needs to tell in their marketing?
6cdaa58b92.a: The four types of stories are attraction stories, nurturing stories, credibility stories, and sales stories. Attraction stories draw in the type of audience and client you want to call in through sharing identity. Nurturing stories take your people along a journey through a process and help them understand how you work and think. Credibility stories make people understand why you are the person they need to be working with. Sales stories are tied to your experience and directly lead to asking for the sale.

a6c79e1faa.q: Why do most business owners only tell two of the four marketing stories instead of all four?
a6c79e1faa.a: Most people are likely telling some version of an attraction story occasionally, and many are doing nurture stories. Sometimes people hit on a credibility story, but usually it is a credibility-ish story mixed with a nurture story. People are not doing sales stories, which is the story that actually gets you the sales. If you are not getting the sales you want, you are probably not telling sales stories.

8ac8caa309.q: What is the purpose of attraction stories in marketing and how do they help grow your business?
8ac8caa309.a: The overall goal of attraction stories is to attract the type of audience and client you want to call in. They signify the types of traits, identities, and experiences that are commonalities of the people you want to attract. Attraction stories are the ones that are going to grow your following and get more people onto your email list. If you are in your audience growth phase, these attraction type stories are going to get you started on that journey.

95a7da36c5.q: How should you approach credibility stories when you have varied experiences that seem disconnected?
95a7da36c5.a: If you feel as if you have so many varied experiences you do not know how to tie it together, you need to start with your background and where you started. Everything you have done connects and is a skill that connects to why you are uniquely qualified to do this. You do what you do for a reason and you are called to it for a reason. A half hour of working through this can help pull together the threads to see how it all makes sense and why you are the person uniquely qualified.

9a2cc2248a.q: What makes sales stories different from other types of marketing stories and why are they essential?
9a2cc2248a.a: A sales story is tied to your experience and what you have done for clients and directly leads to asking for the sale. In sales stories you are directly tying into your service and talking about how your process is instrumental in people getting the success they want. The core difference in sales stories is asking for that sale, asking for someone to download something, book a sales call, or check out your membership. If you are not getting the sales you want, you are probably not telling sales stories.
